name: Tobias
background: A wealthy linen merchant who operates a shop near the Temple Mount. He provides ceremonial items for Passover preparations.

dialogue.neutral: Business is brisk this week. Everyone needs something for the Passover.
dialogue.cautious: I keep to myself mostly. These are dangerous times.
dialogue.pressured: I heard things in the marketplace. Men making plans in hushed tones.
dialogue.exposed: Enough! I saw the transaction happen. Thirty silver pieces changed hands for a kiss.

genericReactions.physical: My colt... it was an honor to provide it for the King.
genericReactions.testimonial: They said 'The Lord needs it.' I understood immediately.
genericReactions.digital: The prophecy of Zechariah is the only record I need.
genericReactions.environmental: My home in Bethphage was the starting point for His entry.
genericReactions.analytical: One colt, for one King. The numbers are simple.
genericReactions.prophecy: I have waited my whole life to see this prophecy fulfilled.
